svg.title: Maple Junction town master plan
svg.desc: North-up model railroad board plan. The five districts are Main Street, Cottage Hill, Switchyard, Mill Pond and the Outskirts. A four-lane slot track crosses the railway at two grade crossings and one raised flyover.
svg.text: Fictional Michigan railroad town · North-up layout
Plan view, with north at the top.
PASS 01 · Street alignments, terrain grades, reserved lots, and track geometry
